steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each invoice is matched to a spend line. An invoice with no spend line, or a spend line with no invoice, is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Invoice with no spend line
findings.fix: Record the spend or query the invoice

findings.title: Amount difference between invoice and spend

outcome.notChecked: Whether the media or goods were delivered; tax treatment, which a qualified adviser confirms.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] invoice-2302.md:12  Invoice with no spend line.
       Fix: Record the spend or query the invoice.
[medium] spend-line-b.csv:19  Duplicate invoice.
       Fix: Reject the duplicate.
[medium] invoice-2303.md:26  Amount difference between invoice and spend.
       Fix: Reconcile the difference.
Not checked: Whether the media or goods were delivered; tax treatment, which a qualified adviser confirms.
pros: Checks an invoice with no spend line; a spend line with no invoice; an amount difference; a duplicate invoice; spend above the budget line for a channel.
cons: Not checked: Whether the media or goods were delivered; tax treatment, which a qualified adviser confirms.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-spend-reconcile skill on the records for this review.
